subject: Launching our collaboration playbook with Stamppoint
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@stamppoint.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launching our collaboration playbook with Stamppoint

Hi Asha —

Great to meet you earlier this week. Per our conversation I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align on goals, responsibilities, and a pragmatic evaluation timeline so we can get a pilot running without surprises. High level:

- Primary objective: validate Redwood inference for Stamppoint's document ingestion use case (FAQ extraction + lightweight summarization) with latency under 250ms p50.
- Success criteria: 80%+ extraction precision on the QA set, stable throughput for 10 concurrent users, and cost estimates for steady-state.
- Proposed pilot window: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-28 (4 weeks) with a 2-week internal prep period.

I attached a one-page MAP draft and the Redwood overview (see attachments). Below are the roles I suggest for clarity — please edit:

- Champion (customer): Asha Patel — coordinate internal stakeholders and approve go/no-go
- AE (Redwood): Hannah Schmitt — MAP owner, timeline, and commercial coordination
- Solutions Engineer (Redwood): Ben Carter — technical kickoff, infra requirements, and validation harness
- Customer Eng lead (customer): Liam O'Connor — owns data access and test environment setup

Next steps: could we schedule a 30–45 minute MAP review next week? I’m available Tues/Wed morning PST. If that works I’ll post a calendar invite and share the editable MAP (Google Sheet).

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

- 2026-08-24: Compliance checklist submitted (Stamppoint)

Roles & responsibilities (short):
- Asha (Champion): stakeholder coordination, final approval
- Liam (Customer Eng): data delivery, sandbox setup, single-point-of-contact for infra questions
- Ben (SE): validation harness, latency/load tests, integration checklist
- Hannah (AE): timeline, commercial constraints, and post-pilot next steps

Action items for this week:
- Asha: confirm compliance submission date and include security reviewer on the MAP sheet
- Liam: confirm sandbox host IPs and sample dataset size by 8/24
- Ben: I’ve included a short list of infra questions in the MAP (sheet row 4); can you review and call out anything missing?

If that looks right I’ll schedule the MAP review for Tue 8/25 at 10:00 AM PST and send a Google Sheet link (editable).

On Tue, Aug 17, 2026 at 1:45 PM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I updated the MAP draft (attached) and added milestone check-ins...

Quick technical notes from my side:

- For the initial pilot we recommend a 50k-doc sample (JSONL) with representative distribution across document types. That will let us exercise batching and KV cache behavior.
- Sandbox spec: 2 x A100-equivalent GPUs or a dedicated burst pool; if you can share preferred cloud region we’ll pin node placement to reduce cross-region egress.
- Data access: a presigned S3 bucket or secure SFTP works; please avoid sharing production DB snapshots.

I’m available for a short sync Thurs 8/20 9:00–11:00 PST if you want to walk through the infra checklist. Otherwise I’ll review the MAP and add technical acceptance criteria to row 6.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
